label: Chiang Mai
short_description: Hotels in the northern Thai cultural capital of temples, night markets and mountains.
intro: Chiang Mai's coverage in this directory is centered on Thailand's northern cultural capital -- a city of walled Old Town temples, riverside night markets along the Ping, and a mountain-and-hill-tribe hinterland. Cooler and more laid-back than Bangkok, it suits culture, food and nature travel, and is reached via Chiang Mai International Airport (CNX) just southwest of the centre.
